dish: zenzai (sweet red-bean soup) served in two bowls
w: The Hōzenji Yokochō sweet shop that gave Oda Sakunosuke's novel its name — each order of less-sweet zenzai comes split into two bowls, the 'husband and wife'. Inside Osaka places it just beyond the moss-covered Fudō-myōō.

dish: crab kaiseki and boiled/grilled snow crab
n: Kani Doraku Dōtonbori Honten (かに道楽 道頓堀本店)
w: The Osaka-born crab house whose giant moving 3D crab sign is one of Dōtonbori's iconic photo spots (Time Out); the honten serves crab course menus.

n: Kinryu Ramen Dōtonbori (金龍ラーメン)
w: Osaka late-night institution since the early '80s, open 24 hours under its giant dragon sculpture (Time Out); the Aioibashi honten is the chain's flagship (ja.wikipedia).
A century-old Dōtonbori beef house: Time Out calls it legendary for melt-in-the-mouth wagyu sukiyaki and shabu-shabu; ja.wikipedia documents the honten.

n: Dōtonbori Kamukura (どうとんぼり神座)
w: OSAKA-INFO's 'roots of popular chains' feature sends fans on pilgrimage to Kamukura's Osaka original stores; ja.wikipedia documents the Dōtonbori-born ramen chain and its vegetable-sweet broth.
Osaka's dark-soy 'Osaka Black' ramen specialist; OSAKA-INFO lists the Dōtonbori shop and ja.wikipedia covers the Osaka-founded brand.

dish: nikusui (beef broth with soft egg, udon removed)
w: Birthplace of Osaka's nikusui — meat udon minus the udon, invented for a hungover Yoshimoto comedian; OSAKA-INFO (2026) and ja.wikipedia's 肉吸い article both credit Chitose.

dish: freshly baked jiggly cheesecake with raisins
n: Rikuro Ojisan no Mise Namba Honten (りくろーおじさんの店)
w: Osaka's beloved fluffy raisin-bottomed cheesecake, branded with the uncle's face and baked to order (OSAKA-INFO, Dec 2025); the Namba shop is the company's honten (ja.wikipedia).

n: Takoya Dōtonbori Kukuru Honten (たこ家道頓堀くくる)
w: Inside Osaka calls the giant-octopus-signed stall a super-popular Dōtonbori takoyaki stop known for its 'surprise' takoyaki; Time Out: 'the Kukuru chain never disappoints'.
Sister to Portland's Bible Club: a basement pre-Prohibition bar with antique crystal and a deep American/Scotch whisky list (Time Out; 50Best Discovery).
